# QuickTap

> QuickTap is a premium NFC card and tag brand based in Egypt. Our products let users share their digital profiles, contact information, and social links with a single tap on any NFC-enabled smartphone. No app required.

## About
- Company: QuickTap
- Founded: 2024
- Location: Cairo, Egypt
- Website: https://quicktap-tags.vercel.app/
- Contact: quicktaptags@hotmail.com
- Languages: Arabic, English

## Products
- [QuickTap Smart Card](https://quicktap-tags.vercel.app//#order): Premium NFC business card with custom design. Price: EGP 500.
- [QuickTap Smart Tag](https://quicktap-tags.vercel.app//#order): Adhesive NFC tag for existing cards. Price: EGP 300.

## Features
- One-tap sharing via NFC
- No app required
- Fully customizable design
- Instant link updates without changing the card
- Compatible with any modern NFC-enabled phone
- Analytics dashboard

## FAQ
- Q: What is QuickTap?
  A: A premium NFC card that shares your digital profile with one tap.
- Q: Do I need an app?
  A: No. Works natively with any NFC-enabled phone.
- Q: Can I update my links?
  A: Yes, anytime through your dashboard.
- Q: Where can I order?
  A: Directly from quicktap-tags.vercel.app . Delivery across Cairo and Giza in 3-5 business days.

## How it works
1. Order your QuickTap card
2. Tap it on any NFC-enabled phone
3. Your digital profile opens instantly in the browser
